## Where the census stands

The initiative I've carried across this session has taken the census **15 → 10**: I proved and flipped **B12** (Kummer surjectivity) and **B11b** (unramified unit-norms) in full, and deleted the unused **B2**; parallel lanes landed **B7′** and **B13** the same day. The remaining ten (B1, B3c, B4, B5, B6, B7, B8, B9, B10′, B11a) are the genuinely deep local-arithmetic and anabelian inputs — local Tate duality, the Euler characteristic, the Demushkin presentation, the tame quotient, the Stix cyclotomic action, the Evens–Kahn formula, and the Hilbert-symbol norm criterion — each still a faithfully-stated, source-verified leaf.
